  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My purchases have mostly helped me connect or use existing equipment; streaming devices, smart speakers, and security cameras introduce uses I have not expressed a need for.",
    "Having bought a headset does not mean I need wireless earbuds now, and having bought a tablet mount does not mean I need a replacement tablet.",
    "None of these items solves a clear current problem for me, so I would skip them rather than interact just because they are electronics."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat an interest in computer accessories as an interest in smart-home and entertainment devices generally.",
    "The list seems to favor widely purchased devices, but their popularity does not give me a practical reason to choose them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, following other connectivity purchases such as a DVI cable, USB expansion card, and WiFi adapter; the useful connection between them is helping existing equipment work together.",
    "My purchases are spaced far apart and address specific needs, so an older accessory purchase is weak evidence that I want another related device today.",
    "Compatibility and a clear practical purpose would matter more to me than simply being another electronic device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions read my practical accessory purchases as broad interest in consumer electronics and missed the specific connectivity needs that make an item relevant to me."
}
